facts.fact: A journal study of 350 respondents in Dar es Salaam City Council finds the Integrated Land Management Information System (ILMIS) has reduced land disputes and transaction times where fully implemented.
The journal study says ILMIS is integrated with other government functions such as tax administration.
The journal study says ILMIS has improved the accuracy of ownership records in areas where it is fully implemented, as seen in Dar es Salaam City Council.

TZA.note: A land system study; no council office connection stated.
A land information system study; no local institution named as researching digital policy.
